packageRules.description: design-system restarted its versions at 1.0.x. The 1.1.0 to 2.4.0 releases are deprecated and older, so Renovate offers 1.0.x only.
prBodyNotes: Before merging, read the design-system release notes for every version in this range. If one changes an export, a theme file, a token name, or a type that `./theme` re-exports, push an empty `fix(deps)!:` commit to this branch whose footer starts with the `BREAKING CHANGE` token and a colon, then says what consumers must change, in one line under 100 characters. Merge with a merge commit, never a rebase merge. Otherwise merge as is: this PR's `fix(deps)` commit releases a patch.
